scene: Six screens off one handset, saved by the background writer at whatever moment it happened to run. Three of them are the same job list caught at three different instants: once between refreshes, once while a refresh was in flight, once while a refresh was waiting for signal. The other three are a survey the writer caught between the banner clearing and the screen catching up, a survey it caught the other way round, and a visits list two pages deep. The app is opened and each screen is entered in turn; the depot is answering.
